In Banking & Financial Services, iot, digital twin & robotics bridges the physical and digital enterprise: industrial sensor fabric, digital twin platforms, computer vision and edge ai, predictive maintenance, robotics and autonomous systems integration, connected products, and smart infrastructure. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: industrial iot & sensor fabric, digital twin platform engineering, computer vision & edge ai — delivered on BI & Analytics Platform and EEMS Platform with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Customer due diligence refresh cycles lag behind actual risk changes; files queue for weeks in review pools while remediation backlogs grow. Manual file assembly across registries, screening tools and core systems consumes analyst hours that produce no judgment.
GenAI stuck between pilot and policy

Generative assistants for credit memos, research summaries and client drafts stall in model-risk review because guardrails, provenance and audit trails were not designed in. Shadow AI fills the gap, creating exactly the exposure the review was meant to prevent.

Credit, market, liquidity and operational risk live in separate estates with divergent reference data. Regulatory reporting leans on manual workarounds, and lineage questions that regulators now ask take expeditions instead of queries.
